description: This PHP file defines a test class 'FormatWithLanguageTest' which extends 'KernelTestCase'. It is part of the test suite for the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing the 'FormatWithLanguage' class related to access strategy formatting. The class sets up test fixtures and contains a test method to verify the formatted value returned by 'FormatWithLanguage'.

classes.name: FormatWithLanguageTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the 'FormatWithLanguage' class. It sets up test data and verifies the output of its 'getFormattedValue' method.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by loading fixtures and initializing the 'FormatWithLanguage' object.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests the 'getFormattedValue' method of 'FormatWithLanguage' for specific input IDs, checking expected string output or null.
